title: Form submits over plaintext HTTP in html — review required
description: A form whose action is an http:// URL submits its fields in clear text. Any on-path observer reads them, and the response can be replaced, which matters most for login and payment forms. The rule flags the literal action; whether the endpoint redirects to HTTPS before the body is sent is a review decision.
remediation: Use an https:// action and enable HSTS so the browser refuses to downgrade.
limitation: Lexical: matches a literal http action; a form whose action is built by script is out of scope.
